title: Theory stays abstract
body: Lessons teach scales and chords in isolation. It is hard to connect them to the progression you are actually writing.

title: Improvising needs memory
body: Picking notes over a chord change means knowing which scale fits, right when you play. Most students do not have that ready yet.

title: Feel is hard to name
body: Every key and scale carries a mood. Naming that mood, and using it on purpose, takes years of listening.
